commits.message: refactor: reuse the checkout http client across requests
commits.author: dev-b
commits.patch:
--- services/checkout/http.py
@@ -8,15 +8,30 @@
-    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as c:

+    return await c.post(url, json=body)
